architecture: 1 -> 48 tanh -> 48 tanh -> 1 linear, all biases, Xavier normal weights and zero biases
test: 4096 uniform random inputs, independent generator seed 123456

training.reason: Retained pilot before scaling objective; seed1 skipped this ineffective stage.

loss_scaling_reason: A positive scalar leaves MSE minimizers unchanged and prevents the optimizer's absolute curvature thresholds prematurely suppressing updates.
head_refit: scipy.linalg.lstsq, gelsd, cutoff in [1e-10,1e-12,1e-14,1e-15] selected using validation only
model_selection: All train/checkpoint choices used train/validation, never test. Geometric variants include exploratory post-training choices, transparently reported. This is a controlled mechanistic experiment, not a pre-registered benchmark.
